title: Ab Na Aaoge Palat Kar
body:
sugrah ne roo kar ye kaha ....(2)
ab na aaoge palath kar ye bathaa the jaathe.....(2)
mujhko ehsaas yatheemi...(2) ka dilaathe jaathe
ab na aaoge palath kar ye bathaa the jaathe.....(2)

my hun beemaar my marjaon tho mere baba...(2)

kab talak raha takun ashq bahaon kab tak...(2)

mujhko baaraat me le jaana nahi gar manzoor

bhaiya asgar ko my kuch aur julaalon jhula...(2)

jaake zindaan me banani hai sakeena ki lehed...(2)

ab na aaoge palath kar ye bathaa the jaathe.....(2)
dek maroof ke rehan se kehtha hai koi ...(2)
aake majlis me tho ...(2) ye noha sunaathe jaathe
sugrah ne roo kar ye kaha ...(2)
